finding: The frozen CW11.3 evaluator started its timer before coherent-AR control generation and stopped it after empirical-candidate generation, then labeled that combined duration as candidate generation cost.
scope: Correct timer boundaries only. Do not regenerate or change distribution evidence, sampler outputs, seeds, metrics, thresholds, source folds, or promotion requirements.

sampler.seed_function: Unchanged sha256 of cw11.3 source and arm
sampler.required_identity: Every regenerated candidate array must be exactly equal to its saved CW11.3 empirical_innovation array.

timing_protocol.fold_statistic: median measured milliseconds per valid token per sample
timing_protocol.cross_fold_statistic: p95 across the twelve fold medians

decision.pass: If candidate identity passes on all folds and corrected p95 is below the unchanged 0.25 threshold, restore the already-passed distribution gates and proceed to compiled safety.
decision.fail: Retain coherent AR and close CW11.3 performance-negative.

claim_limit: Instrumentation correction only; it cannot change the scientific distribution result or promotion threshold.
